project.name: waydroid-container
project.description: Waydroid (official LineageOS-based vendor Android image) run headless inside a Docker container, decoupled from the live desktop Wayland session — the ghost-process bug that got the original desktop-session Waydroid decommissioned CANNOT recur, because the container's lifecycle is independent of the desktop session. Renders into a nested headless weston compositor (RDP backend — Debian bookworm's weston 10.0.1 package has NO vnc-backend.so, only rdp-backend.so + headless-backend.so, verified by inspecting the built image) inside the container; the host connects with xfreerdp in a window to see it (same GUI-bound up=boot+attach/down=teardown-on-close pattern as da_redroid, just a different display transport — scrcpy mirrors ADB/SurfaceFlinger, RDP mirrors a Wayland compositor). Exists because Waydroid's vendor image is memfd-based (no real /dev/ashmem needed) since 1.2.1+, so Chromium-based apps that crash under redroid (this host's mainline kernel has no ashmem) should work here — that's the whole point of this project.

container._doc: Docker container knobs. image is OUR built image (Debian + waydroid + weston), never a public upstream tag — Waydroid has no official Docker image. base_image is what we build FROM.
container._doc_rdp: weston 10.0.1 (Debian bookworm)'s rdp-backend.so CLI has NO --rdp-user/--rdp-pass flags (verified via `weston --help` inside the built image) — only --rdp4-key or --rdp-tls-cert/--rdp-tls-key for transport encryption, no app-level login. Auth model confirmed empirically at container-boot time; port is bound to 127.0.0.1 only regardless (never exposed beyond the host).

waydroid._doc: waydroid CLI invocation knobs (manual, non-systemd — 'waydroid container start' + 'waydroid session start' are direct commands, no systemctl dependency, confirmed from docs.waydro.id/usage/waydroid-command-line-options).
